subliminal_manipulation.label: Manipulates people below their awareness
subliminal_manipulation.help: Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques that distort behaviour and cause significant harm.

exploiting_vulnerabilities.label: Exploits vulnerable people
exploiting_vulnerabilities.help: Takes advantage of age, disability or a social or economic situation to distort behaviour harmfully.

social_scoring.label: Social scoring
social_scoring.help: Rates people on social behaviour or personality, leading to unfair treatment in unrelated contexts.

crime_prediction_profiling.label: Predicts crime from profiling
crime_prediction_profiling.help: Predicts whether a person will commit a crime based only on profiling or personality traits.

untargeted_face_scraping.label: Scrapes faces to build a database
untargeted_face_scraping.help: Builds face recognition databases by untargeted scraping from the internet or CCTV.

emotion_recognition_work_education.label: Recognises emotions at work or school
emotion_recognition_work_education.help: Infers emotions of employees or students, except for medical or safety reasons.

biometric_categorisation_sensitive.label: Sorts people by sensitive traits from biometrics
biometric_categorisation_sensitive.help: Infers race, political opinions, union membership, religion, sex life or orientation from biometric data.

realtime_remote_biometric_id.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in public
realtime_remote_biometric_id.help: Identifies people live, at a distance, in publicly accessible places for law enforcement.

biometrics.label: Biometrics
biometrics.help: Remote biometric identification, categorisation by sensitive traits, or emotion recognition. Simply confirming that someone is who they claim to be doesn't count.

critical_infrastructure.label: Critical infrastructure
critical_infrastructure.help: A safety component in running digital infrastructure, road traffic, or water, gas, heating or electricity supply.

education.label: Education and training
education.help: Deciding admission, grading learning outcomes, steering education levels or watching for cheating in tests.

employment.label: Employment and workers
employment.help: Recruiting or screening candidates, deciding promotions or dismissals, allocating tasks, or monitoring workers' performance.

essential_public_services.label: Public benefits and services
essential_public_services.help: Public authorities deciding who gets benefits and services such as healthcare, or reducing or revoking them.

creditworthiness.label: Creditworthiness and credit scoring
creditworthiness.help: Evaluating whether a person is creditworthy, or setting their credit score. Not covered: systems used only to detect financial fraud (Annex III, point 5(b)).

life_health_insurance.label: Life and health insurance
life_health_insurance.help: Assessing risk and setting prices for individuals in life or health insurance.

emergency_triage.label: Emergency calls and triage
emergency_triage.help: Evaluating emergency calls, dispatching police, fire or ambulance services, or triaging patients.

law_enforcement.label: Law enforcement
law_enforcement.help: Used by or for police: assessing victims, evidence reliability, reoffending risk, or profiling in investigations.

migration_border.label: Migration, asylum and border control
migration_border.help: Assessing risks of people entering, examining asylum, visa or residence applications, or detecting people at borders.

justice_democracy.label: Justice and elections
justice_democracy.help: Helping courts research or apply the law, or influencing how people vote in elections or referendums.

none.label: None of these
none.help: The system influences decisions about people, so it stays high-risk.

narrow_procedural_task.label: A narrow procedural task
narrow_procedural_task.help: For example turning unstructured documents into structured data, or sorting incoming documents into categories.

improves_completed_human_activity.label: Improves work a person has already finished
improves_completed_human_activity.help: For example polishing the language of a letter someone already wrote.

detects_patterns_without_replacing_revie.label: Spots patterns for a person to review
detects_patterns_without_replacing_revie.help: It flags deviations from earlier decisions, but doesn't replace or influence the person's assessment without proper review.

preparatory_task.label: Prepares an assessment a person makes
preparatory_task.help: For example indexing, searching or translating files that a person then assesses.

interacts_with_people.label: People talk to it directly
interacts_with_people.help: For example a chatbot or voice assistant, unless it is obvious they are dealing with AI.

generates_synthetic_content.label: It generates images, audio, video or text
generates_synthetic_content.help: Synthetic content that could pass as made by a person.

emotion_recognition_or_biometric_categor.label: It recognises emotions or sorts people by biometrics
emotion_recognition_or_biometric_categor.help: People exposed to it must be told it is running.

deep_fake.label: It produces deep fakes
deep_fake.help: Images, audio or video that resemble real people, places or events and could seem authentic.

public_interest_text.label: It writes text published to inform the public
public_interest_text.help: Text on matters of public interest, unless a person reviews it and takes editorial responsibility.

reasons.unknown: A rule of the Regulation applies.
reasons.not_ai_system: It isn't an AI system as the Regulation defines one, so the Regulation doesn't apply.

prohibited.subliminal_manipulation: It manipulates people below their awareness, which is prohibited.
prohibited.exploiting_vulnerabilities: It exploits vulnerable people, which is prohibited.
prohibited.social_scoring: It scores people on social behaviour, which is prohibited.
prohibited.crime_prediction_profiling: It predicts crime from profiling alone, which is prohibited.
prohibited.untargeted_face_scraping: It builds face databases by untargeted scraping, which is prohibited.
prohibited.emotion_recognition_work_education: It recognises emotions at work or in education, which is prohibited.
prohibited.biometric_categorisation_sensitive: It infers sensitive traits from biometrics, which is prohibited.
prohibited.realtime_remote_biometric_id: It identifies people remotely in real time in public, which is prohibited.

annex_i.safety_component: It is a safety component of a product under Annex I, so it is high-risk.

annex_iii.biometrics: It is used for biometrics, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.critical_infrastructure: It is used in critical infrastructure, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.education: It is used in education or training, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.employment: It is used in employment or managing workers, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.essential_public_services: It decides access to public benefits or services, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.creditworthiness: It evaluates creditworthiness or sets credit scores, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.life_health_insurance: It prices or assesses risk in life or health insurance, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.emergency_triage: It is used for emergency calls or triage, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.law_enforcement: It is used in law enforcement, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.migration_border: It is used in migration, asylum or border control, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.justice_democracy: It is used in justice or elections, a high-risk use.
annex_iii.profiling: It profiles people, so it stays high-risk whatever its task.
annex_iii.no_derogation: None of the exceptions for narrow or supporting tasks applies, so it is high-risk.

derogation.narrow_procedural_task: It only does a narrow procedural task, so it isn't high-risk. Record this assessment.
derogation.improves_completed_human_activity: It only improves work a person has finished, so it isn't high-risk. Record this assessment.
derogation.detects_patterns_without_replacing_revie: It only spots patterns for a person to review, so it isn't high-risk. Record this assessment.
derogation.preparatory_task: It only prepares an assessment a person makes, so it isn't high-risk. Record this assessment.

transparency.interacts_with_people: People talk to it directly, so they must be told they are dealing with AI.
transparency.generates_synthetic_content: It generates content, which must be marked as AI-generated.
transparency.emotion_recognition_or_biometric_categor: It recognises emotions or sorts people by biometrics, so people must be told.
transparency.deep_fake: It produces deep fakes, which must be disclosed as such.
transparency.public_interest_text: It writes text for the public, which must be disclosed as AI-generated.

reasons.minimal_risk: No high-risk use or transparency duty applies: it is minimal risk, with voluntary codes of conduct only.

obligationTitles.eu_declaration_and_ce_marking: Sign the EU declaration and add the CE mark
obligationTitles.keep_logs_six_months: Keep the logs for six months
obligationTitles.inform_workers: Inform workers before use at work
obligationTitles.inform_affected_people: Tell people it is used on them
obligationTitles.fundamental_rights_impact_assessment: Assess the impact on fundamental rights
obligationTitles.importer_verification: Check the system before importing it
obligationTitles.distributor_verification: Check the system before distributing it
obligationTitles.disclose_ai_interaction: Tell people they are talking to AI
obligationTitles.inform_emotion_or_biometric_exposure: Tell people about emotion or biometric analysis

obligationDescriptions.ai_literacy: Give the people who run or use this system enough training to understand what it does, its limits and its risks. Record who was trained, when, and on what.
obligationDescriptions.stop_prohibited_practice: This use is banned in the EU. Stop it, or change the system so the practice no longer happens, and record when and how you did so.
obligationDescriptions.risk_management_system: Identify and assess the risks the system poses to health, safety and fundamental rights, decide measures for each, test them, and review the whole process regularly over the system's life.
obligationDescriptions.data_governance: Document where training, validation and test data come from, check them for errors, gaps and bias, and record how you prepared them.
obligationDescriptions.technical_documentation: Write and keep up to date a description of the system's design, purpose, data, testing and performance, detailed enough for an authority to check compliance (Annex IV).
obligationDescriptions.automatic_logging: Build the system so it records events while it runs, enough to trace what happened, find risks and support monitoring.
obligationDescriptions.instructions_for_deployers: Provide clear instructions that tell deployers what the system is for, its accuracy and limits, the human oversight it needs and how to read its outputs.
obligationDescriptions.human_oversight_by_design: Build in ways for people to understand, monitor, override and stop the system, and say in the instructions how oversight should work.
obligationDescriptions.accuracy_robustness_security: Set and measure accuracy levels, test that the system copes with errors and misuse, and protect it against attacks such as data poisoning.
obligationDescriptions.quality_management_system: Have written policies and procedures covering design, testing, data, risk management, monitoring, incident reporting and who is responsible for each.
obligationDescriptions.conformity_assessment: Before placing the system on the market, carry out the conformity assessment that applies to it, internally or with a notified body, and keep the results.
obligationDescriptions.eu_declaration_and_ce_marking: Draw up and sign the EU declaration of conformity, keep it for ten years, and put the CE marking on the system or its documentation.
obligationDescriptions.eu_database_registration: Register the system and your organisation in the EU database for high-risk AI systems before placing it on the market or putting it into service.
obligationDescriptions.post_market_monitoring: Collect and review data on how the system performs once it is in use, following a written monitoring plan, and act on what you find.
obligationDescriptions.serious_incident_reporting: Agree who reports, to which market surveillance authority, and how. Report any serious incident without delay once you know of it, and within the legal deadline.
obligationDescriptions.corrective_actions: When the system doesn't conform, fix it, withdraw or recall it as needed, and inform distributors, deployers and, where there is a risk, the authorities.
obligationDescriptions.use_per_instructions: Read the provider's instructions for use and put technical and organisational measures in place so the system is used only as they describe.
obligationDescriptions.assign_human_oversight: Name the people who oversee the system, make sure they have the skills, training and authority to do it, and give them the support they need.
obligationDescriptions.input_data_quality: Where you control the input data, make sure it is relevant and representative enough for the system's intended purpose.
obligationDescriptions.monitor_and_report: Watch how the system works in practice. If it presents a risk, or a serious incident happens, stop using it where needed and inform the provider and the authority.
obligationDescriptions.keep_logs_six_months: Keep the logs the system generates, as far as they are under your control, for at least six months, or longer if other law requires.
obligationDescriptions.inform_workers: Before using the system at work, tell the workers concerned and their representatives that they will be subject to it.
obligationDescriptions.inform_affected_people: When the system makes or helps make decisions about people, tell them that a high-risk AI system is used in decisions about them.
obligationDescriptions.dpia_where_required: Use the provider's information to carry out a data protection impact assessment under GDPR Art. 35 where one is required.
obligationDescriptions.right_to_explanation: Be ready to give a person affected by a decision based on the system a clear explanation of the system's role and the main elements of the decision.
obligationDescriptions.fundamental_rights_impact_assessment: Before first use, assess how the system could affect people's fundamental rights: who is affected, the risks, human oversight and what you do if risks materialise. Notify the authority of the result.
obligationDescriptions.importer_verification: Before placing it on the market, check that the provider did the conformity assessment, drew up the documentation, added the CE mark and appointed a representative. Put your name and contact on it.
obligationDescriptions.distributor_verification: Before making it available, check that it carries the CE mark, comes with the declaration of conformity and instructions, and that the provider and importer met their duties.
obligationDescriptions.document_not_high_risk_assessment: Write down your assessment of why the system is not high-risk despite its Annex III use, before placing it on the market, and give it to the authorities on request.
obligationDescriptions.register_not_high_risk: Register the system in the EU database even though you assessed it as not high-risk.
obligationDescriptions.disclose_ai_interaction: Design the system so people are told they are interacting with AI, at the latest at their first interaction, unless it is obvious.
obligationDescriptions.mark_synthetic_content: Make the images, audio, video or text the system generates detectable as AI-generated, in a machine-readable format.
obligationDescriptions.inform_emotion_or_biometric_exposure: Tell the people exposed to the system that it recognises emotions or sorts people by biometrics, and handle their data under the GDPR.
obligationDescriptions.disclose_deep_fake: Say clearly that images, audio or video you publish were generated or changed by AI.
obligationDescriptions.disclose_ai_generated_text: Say that text published to inform the public was generated by AI, unless a person reviewed it and takes editorial responsibility.
